firm_data.firm_description: Herman Law Firm is a boutique law firm representing health insurers, self-funded plans, and plan administrators. They focus on reimbursement disputes and advise clients on regulatory matters pertaining to Medicaid, Marketplace, and Medicare.
notable_facts: Publishes Managed Care Litigation Update, a bi-weekly electronic publication.
Represents health insurers in high-profile cases navigating healthcare laws.
Offices in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Massachusetts & California
technology_signals: Uses cutting-edge technology in the firm and in the courtroom (according to website).
